intent: React-Hook-Form + Zod form context with accessible field wiring.

chooseOver.because: Form wires React-Hook-Form + Zod validation, accessible field context, and inline errors; raw form state gives you none of that

commonMistakes.mistake: Rendering FormField outside a Form/useForm context
commonMistakes.symptom: FormField throws / has no form state (see fm-form-2)
commonMistakes.fix: Wrap fields in <Form> with a useForm() instance
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Render FormField outside a Form/useForm context (see fm-form-2)

usage: Use Form to organize form elements and create structured data entry interfaces. This component helps maintain consistency and accessibility in form layouts.
Form works best when grouping related form fields together. Ensure proper labeling, validation, and error handling. Consider the logical flow of information when arranging form elements.

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
